reason: We're booked for months and my office already handles the phone; a missed call costs me nothing right now. I'm not fiddling with call forwarding for a problem I don't have.
objection: I don't want anyone messing with my phone setup, and a brand-new company with no customers handling my callers in my name is a risk I don't need.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check showed regular customers or emergencies actually slipping through and getting lost, I might switch on the ausgebucht mode.
